result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services.

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs.

We currently have a full-time opportunity for a Maintenance Systems & Compliance Supervisor to join our Building Services team and support the delivery of safe, reliable and efficient hospital operations.

Reporting to the Facilities Engineering Manager, you will oversee the Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) program, statutory compliance, contractor governance and facilities systems across a complex private hospital. You will play a key role in ensuring regulatory compliance, improving system performance and maintaining the integrity of our maintenance and asset management systems.

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

Coordinate and oversee the Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) program, ensuring maintenance activities are completed, documented and compliant with statutory and organisational requirements.

Maintain statutory compliance records, certifications, service reports and asset information within the Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

Act as the system owner for facilities management platforms, maintaining data integrity and driving continuous system improvements.

Monitor contractor performance and ensure documentation complies with contractual, safety and regulatory requirements.

Coordinate audits, inspections and compliance reporting activities.

Manage the hospital's car parking portfolio, including system administration, access management, application processing, waitlist management and process governance.

Analyse maintenance performance data and identify opportunities to improve asset reliability, compliance and operational performance.

Coordinate purchase orders, contractor quotations and planned maintenance documentation to support the timely delivery of maintenance services.

Skills and experience:

Trade qualification or tertiary qualification in engineering, building services, facilities management or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in a building, engineering or facilities environment.

Experience managing planned maintenance programs, statutory compliance or facilities management systems.

Strong understanding of WHS legislation, contractor management and safe work practices.

Experience using Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

High attention to detail with excellent documentation and record management skills.

Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.

Well-developed communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships across contractors, operational teams and key stakeholders

Ability to prioritise competing workloads, manage multiple activities simultaneously and work autonomously.

Experience within healthcare, aged care, education or other complex facilities is highly desirable.

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a government salary sacrifice program. Make a proportion of your salary tax-free

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

About the hospital

In this role you will be based at St Vincent's private hospital, Darlinghurst.

A state-of-the art hospital in a beautiful inner-city location

Surrounded by great cafes, galleries and theatres, parks, nightlife, and nearby glorious beaches

Closely partnered with universities & affiliated research institutes, many of which are located on-campus

Groundbreaking technologies, including world-first robotic-assisted surgeries

Highly specialized services in orthopaedics, heart and lung, head and neck, neurosurgery, urology, vascular surgery, upper GI-hepatobiliary surgery, ENT, colorectal surgery, gynaecology, neurology, plastic and reconstructive surgery, cancer services, and mental health

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role-required pre-employment checks, including relevant immunisations.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

As part of our commitment to reconciliation we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in delivering care that heals body, mind, spirit and community.

How to apply

The closing date for applications is Friday 31st July. Candidates may be selected and called for interview in the interim so please apply soonest.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with each of the things listed in the About You section of this job advert.

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

Closing Date:
30 July 2026 11:59pm

result.description: HELLO AUSSIE STUDENT SERVICES  The Architectural Draftsperson – Cabinetry & Joinery is responsible for preparing detailed architectural drafting, shop drawings, production documentation and construction details for custom residential and commercial cabinetry, joinery and fitted furniture projects. The position interprets architectural plans, client requirements and project specifications to produce accurate technical documentation that supports fabrication, installation and project delivery. The role works closely with builders, architects, clients, estimators and production staff to ensure designs are practical, compliant, manufacturable and accurately documented.   Benefits   Competitive salary plus superannuation.  Work on high-end custom cabinetry and joinery projects.  Opportunity to use advanced CAD software, including Cabinet Vision and AutoCAD.  Ongoing professional development and technical training.  Supportive and collaborative team environment.  Career progression opportunities within a growing Australian cabinetry business.  Exposure to diverse residential and commercial projects.  Modern workplace with a strong focus on quality, innovation and continuous improvement.    Task & responsibilities  Architectural Drafting & Documentation  •    Prepare detailed architectural drafting, shop drawings, working drawings and fabrication documentation for custom cabinetry, joinery and fitted furniture projects.  •    Interpret architectural plans, design specifications and client requirements to prepare accurate production and installation documentation.  •    Produce detailed layouts, elevations, sections, construction details and joinery drawings using Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD and other CAD software.  •    Prepare schedules, cutting lists, material specifications and component documentation required for manufacturing and installation.  •    Ensure all drawings accurately reflect project specifications, dimensions and construction requirements.  Project Coordination  •    Review architectural drawings, site measurements and construction documentation to verify design accuracy and constructability.  •    Liaise with architects, builders, site supervisors, clients and internal departments to clarify project requirements and resolve technical drafting issues.  •    Amend drawings and technical documentation to accommodate approved design changes, site conditions and construction requirements.  •    Participate in project coordination meetings and provide technical drafting support throughout the project lifecycle.  Production & Installation Support  •    Prepare production documentation that supports efficient fabrication, assembly and installation.  •    Provide technical drafting support to manufacturing and installation teams by clarifying construction details and resolving documentation queries.  •    Verify dimensions, joinery details and installation requirements prior to production.  •    Assist in coordinating drawing revisions to minimise production errors and project delays.  Quality & Compliance  •    Ensure drafting documentation complies with relevant Australian Standards, construction requirements and company drafting procedures.  •    Conduct quality reviews of drawings to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness before issue.  •    Maintain document control procedures and ensure current revisions are distributed to relevant stakeholders.  •    Maintain accurate project records, drawing registers and technical documentation throughout each project.  Continuous Improvement  •    Contribute to the ongoing improvement of drafting standards, documentation systems and CAD procedures.  •    Assist in developing standard drawing templates, drafting procedures and technical documentation practices.  •    Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance drafting accuracy, workflow efficiency and project delivery.      Qualification & experience  Essential Qualifications  •    Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Building Design, Civil Construction Design or a related discipline.  •    Demonstrated experience preparing architectural drafting and technical documentation for cabinetry, joinery or construction projects.    Essential Skills & Experience  •    Advanced proficiency in Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD and other CAD software.  •    Strong understanding of architectural drafting principles and construction documentation.  •    Ability to interpret architectural plans, engineering drawings and construction specifications.  •    Experience preparing shop drawings, fabrication drawings and installation documentation.  •    Sound knowledge of cabinetry construction methods, joinery detailing and manufacturing processes.  •    Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.  •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  •    High level of accuracy and attention to detail.  •    Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $76515-85000   Job Publish:  30-06-2026   Job Expire:  30-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5953253   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

result.description: Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd  Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer to operate CNC machinery and manufacture precision components. The role involves machine setup, machining operations, reading technical drawings, performing quality checks, and ensuring products meet required specifications and standards.   Benefits   Competitive salary based on skills and experience.  Opportunity to work with advanced CNC machinery and precision engineering projects.  Supportive and professional team environment.  Opportunities for career development and skills advancement.  Stable employment with an established Australian manufacturing company.    Task & responsibilities   Set up and operate CNC machining equipment, including CNC milling and turning machines.  Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and production instructions.  Perform machining operations to produce precision components.  Select and change cutting tools, fixtures, and machine settings as required.  Conduct quality checks using measuring equipment such as micrometers, verniers, and gauges.  Identify and resolve machining issues to maintain production efficiency.  Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Follow workplace health and safety procedures and quality control requirements.    Qualification & experience   Relevant trade qualification in machining, engineering, or manufacturing (preferred).  Previous experience as a Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer, or similar role.  Experience operating CNC milling and/or turning machines.  Ability to interpret technical drawings and use precision measuring instruments.  Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling, and quality standards.  Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.   About Company    Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturer based in Brunswick East, Victoria, specialising in vinyl record production and precision-engineered tooling for the global vinyl record industry. Established in 2013, the company combines advanced CNC machining, engineering, and manufacturing expertise to design and produce high-quality molds, tooling, spare parts, and vinyl records for customers in Australia and overseas. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and quality, Zenith Vinyl continues to support the growing global demand for premium vinyl manufacturing solutions. result.description: MYT Framing Solutions  MYT Framing Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Production Operator to assist with the manufacturing and assembly of light gauge steel framing components for residential and commercial construction projects. The role involves operating production machinery, cutting, shaping, assembling and finishing steel framing components, monitoring equipment, conducting quality checks, maintaining safe work practices, and preparing completed products for dispatch.  The successful candidate will support the production of wall frames, roof trusses, floor joists and other structural steel components, ensuring all products are manufactured accurately, efficiently and in accordance with company standards and project specifications.   Benefits   Competitive salary package with Superannuation  Full time job opportunity and long term career prospects  Supportive, team based environment  Ongoing training and skill development opportunities  On site Parking  Task & Responsibilities  Operate production equipment in a safe and efficient manner.  Handle raw materials, including steel components.  Assist with the production, assembly and preparation of frames for construction projects.  Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Follow work instructions and company safety policies.    Task & responsibilities   Operating specialised production machinery and equipment used for cutting, shaping, joining, assembling and finishing steel framing components.  Reading and following production sheets, technical specifications, drawings and work instructions to ensure accurate manufacturing of housing components.  Calibrating machinery, monitoring gauges and making necessary adjustments to maintain smooth and efficient production.  Conducting regular checks on machinery and equipment to ensure safe and effective operation.  Performing basic troubleshooting, minor repairs and adjustments to machinery where required.  Carrying out quality checks on finished components to ensure they meet company standards, project requirements and relevant construction specifications.  Identifying and reporting defects, production issues or equipment faults to supervisors in a timely manner.  Assisting with the packaging, labelling and preparation of completed framing components for dispatch to construction sites.  Checking and maintaining material inventory levels, including assisting with monthly stock counts and warehouse organisation.  Following workplace health and safety procedures, equipment manuals and company policies at all times.  Maintaining a clean, organised and safe production area to support efficient workflow and reduce downtime.  Working collaboratively with production, warehouse, logistics and site teams to ensure orders are completed accurately and delivered on schedule.    Qualification & experience  The successful candidate must have at least  2 year of relevant work experience  in a production, manufacturing, fabrication, construction, steel framing or similar industrial environment.   The candidate should be able to read and follow production sheets, technical drawings, equipment manuals and workplace safety instructions. They should have practical knowledge of machine operation, material handling, basic troubleshooting, quality checking and safe workplace practices.  Experience in light gauge steel framing, structural steel fabrication, warehouse operations, inventory control or dispatch preparation would be advantageous.   The candidate must demonstrate strong attention to detail, good teamwork skills, the ability to follow instructions, and a commitment to maintaining quality, safety and productivity standards.  About Company    MYT Framing Pty Ltd is a South Australian company specialising in light gauge steel framing and structural steel solutions for residential and commercial building projects. The company provides a complete service including drafting, engineering, fabrication, delivery and installation of steel framing components.  MYT Framing works with commercial builders, boutique home builders and property developers, offering reliable advice, precision fabrication and professional installation services. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, accurate and durable steel framing products while maintaining strong standards of safety, efficiency and workmanship. Summary: 
Join a world-leading School of Computer Science and Engineering and help shape the next generation of cybersecurity professionals through innovative, high-quality teaching in areas such as penetration testing, reverse engineering, wargaming, and offensive and defensive security.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in an Education Focused role. In this role, you will contribute to excellence in teaching and learning within cybersecurity, while helping to shape the next generation of cybersecurity professionals and computing graduates.

You will contribute to teaching across areas such as penetration testing, reverse engineering, wargaming, offensive and defensive security, and related cybersecurity disciplines at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. You will play a key role in delivering engaging learning experiences, developing innovative curriculum and teaching approaches, and enhancing student learning outcomes.

With established strengths in cybersecurity, systems, artificial intelligence, and software engineering, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for educators who are passionate about teaching excellence, curriculum innovation, and student success. You will contribute to a collaborative academic community committed to advancing education and preparing students for real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative educational environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to educational excellence, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an engaging and passionate educator with expertise in cybersecurity and a commitment to delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences. You bring knowledge in areas such as penetration testing, reverse engineering, wargaming, and offensive and defensive security, along with the ability to contribute to an inclusive and high-performing academic environment.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will contribute to teaching, curriculum development, and student support across undergraduate and postgraduate courses, while continuing to develop your teaching practice and educational innovation capabilities.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate educational leadership through curriculum innovation, mentoring colleagues, leading teaching initiatives, and contributing to the advancement of teaching excellence across the School and broader UNSW Education Focused community.
You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to create meaningful learning experiences while building strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and professional development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience in work-integrated learning (desirable).
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience in implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of professional development of teaching practice in self and others with the ability to advance and lead an inclusive culture of excellence in learning and teaching.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an educator passionate about delivering high-quality teaching and enhancing the student learning experience, whether as an emerging or experienced academic, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to innovative teaching practices, curriculum development, and educational excellence within the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If you're excited about this role and think you have what it takes, but your experience doesn't align 100%, we still want to hear from you and would encourage you to apply.

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: 
https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-policies/
